build_IntegralRegressionHead: build an IntegralRegressionHead instance with deconv layers and a specified number of joints for pose regression
forward_IntegralRegressionHead: run the forward pass on multi-scale feature maps to get predicted keypoint coordinates and heatmaps
predict_IntegralRegressionHead: predict keypoint coordinates from features with optional flip test TTA and heatmap output
loss_IntegralRegressionHead: calculate SmoothL1 loss and PCK accuracy from predicted coordinates and ground truth keypoint labels
